explanation: List the debt holdings with the lowest prices across the ten BDCs that have the lowest average debt prices, optimizing the query to prevent timeouts.
raw: {"sql": "WITH lowest_bdcs AS (SELECT bdc FROM holdings_v WHERE is_debt = 1 AND price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bdc ORDER BY AVG(price) ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT h.bdc, h.identifier, h.price FROM holdings_v h JOIN lowest_bdcs b ON h.bdc = b.bdc WHERE h.is_debt = 1 AND h.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.price ASC LIMIT 20", "explanation": "List the debt holdings with the lowest prices across the ten BDCs that have the lowest average debt prices, optimizing the query to prevent timeouts."}
sql: WITH lowest_bdcs AS (SELECT bdc FROM holdings_v WHERE is_debt = 1 AND price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bdc ORDER BY AVG(price) ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT h.bdc, h.identifier, h.price FROM holdings_v h JOIN lowest_bdcs b ON h.bdc = b.bdc WHERE h.is_debt = 1 AND h.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.price ASC LIMIT 20
